description: Add a field to a form. Types: text, textarea, integer, float, date, datetime, email, phone, url, select, checkbox, radio, file, image, location, autoincrement, yes_no, rel, formula, linked_column, linked_records, subform, map, action, divider, page_break, note, signature, country, language, states, time_zone, record_owners, matrix. A type's full parameters — get_field_types. ⚠️ For select/checkbox/radio ALWAYS pass choices in the SAME call — without them the field is not created.

action_display_rules.description: Rules for when the Action button is shown. For all records — do not pass this array.

conditions.description: Display conditions (empty = for all records). {property_id, condition, search, join: and|or}

action_done_message.description: action field: the message after the task is done

action_name_column_id.description: action: the id of the field of this form whose value is the button's caption — with action_name_from_column true

action_name_from_column.description: action: the button's caption is taken from a field of the record (action_name_column_id) instead of the field's name

action_tasks.description: Tasks of an Action field (field_type=action). task_type: 0=email, 1=sms, 2=update_record, 3=payment, 4=webhook, 5=open_form_or_url, 6=telegram/whatsapp. The full specification — get_field_types.

email_recipient_source.description: 0 = a list of emails, 1 = from a field, 2 = the record's owners

id.description: A unique task ID (for references from action_display_rules)

task_type.description: See task_type in the description of action_tasks above

update_fields.description: Fields to update (task_type=2). Each object: {field_id, val, set_current_time, set_current_user}

webhook.description: Webhook config: {request_method(0-4), auth_type(0-2), url, webhook_params[], webhook_headers[]}

add_percent_to_number.description: Add a % sign after the number

add_to_actions_control.description: action: add to the bulk actions menu

allow_new_values.description: For select only. true — users can add new options right from the record form, without editing the field. Default false.

average_table_column.description: Not for an average over the rows linked to this record: their sum (linked_records + linked_column) divided by a linked_records_count. formula_type average is refused by this tool.

average_table_ref_column.description: formula_type average: the link field in that other table that points at this form, by id or name; may be left out when only one table links here

choices.description: REQUIRED for select/checkbox/radio: an array of options. A call WITHOUT choices is refused with an error — do not make it; pass the options at once (take them from the user's words or propose sensible ones). Example: ["New", "In progress", "Done"].

column.description: REQUIRED for linked_column: the id of the field of the LINKED table that this column shows — «show the activity's description in the registration form» is a linked_column on Registrations with column = the id of Activities' Description (get_form_fields of that table lists the ids). The two tables must be linked already. Written here, beside settings — not inside settings

default.description: Default value (for select — one of the choices)

dependent.description: rel only: true — the list offers only the rows linked to what another field of the same form holds (Country → City, Stage → Check point); give depends_from_field_id with it. get_field_types with field_type rel says the shape

depends_from_field_id.description: rel only: the field of the same form (name or id) whose pick narrows this list — itself a link to a table that the linked table links to as well

desc.description: A tooltip hint for the person filling in the form

display_as_image.description: true — show the URL as a picture (field_type=url only, for photos)

entries_num.description: Number of linked records for linked_records (default 5)

field.description: Array of field IDs or constants ['Constant', 'text'] for formula_type=formula

field_type.description: Field type. Call get_field_types for the full list with descriptions.

formula_link_column.description: formula_type=link: ID of the field with the table/form name

formula_type.description: Formula type: formula (arithmetic/concatenation), function (built-in functions + Ruby), link (clickable link), total (sum), average (average). REQUIRED for field_type=formula.

func_fields.description: IDs of all fields used in func/script_body. REQUIRED for formula_type=function — without it the formula is not recalculated.

hide_column_name.description: action/formula: hide the column's name in the table

icon.description: action field: the icon's FontAwesome class

icon_align.description: action: where the icon stands beside the caption — 1 left (default), 2 right

linked_entity_id.description: The id of the other table: for linked_records / linked_records_count, and for a subform the table whose rows are filled in inside this form. A linked_column names its table by its column

linked_records_count_form_id.description: ID of the form to count (required for field_type=linked_records_count)

not_add_space_between_operands.description: 1 = no space between the operands (for concatenation without spaces)

operand_is.description: Operand type for formula_type=formula: numbers, decimal, text, days, hours, year. REQUIRED when formula_type=formula.

operation.description: Operators between the fields: +, -, *, / (one fewer than the number of fields)

precision.description: Digits after the decimal point for float (default 2)

rel_entity_id.description: ID of the form the rel field links to (required for rel)

rel_show_field_id.description: ID of the field to show in the rel dropdown (optional)

required.description: true — the field must be filled in

script_body.description: Ruby code for func=4. Rules: the result goes into the variable 'a', the last line is 'a'; field names in single quotes 'field_name'.to_f; def/while/puts/return/require are forbidden; aggregating subforms through .to_f is FORBIDDEN (use linked_column for that).

settings.description: Any other setting of the field, as setting: value pairs in the product's own names — totals and averages under a column, barcode / QR code, an input mask, several files at once, a list's options side by side, pages of a long form, address help, edit in the table, how many fields share a row, a subform's rows (how many, the add link, hidden fields) and what the table shows of a subform or a list of linked records (one column or a small table of chosen columns, their order). Call get_field_types with field_type for the settings that fit one type. Example: {"show_db_total_row": true}. A setting that does not fit the field's type is refused by name.

time_settings.description: time field: how the time is picked. clock_system "12h" | "24h"; control_type "dropdown" | "slider"; units: { hour | minute | second | millisec | microsec: { show: true|false, min, max, step, grid } } — e.g. {"units": {"minute": {"step": 15}, "second": {"show": false}}}. Only what is passed changes

total_table_column.description: Not for a sum over the rows linked to this record — that is a linked_records field and a linked_column over it (937). formula_type total is refused by this tool.

total_table_ref_column.description: Not for a sum over the rows linked to this record (see total_table_column).

truncates_after.description: Cut the text in the table after N characters (default 1000)

uniqueness.description: Check that the field's values are unique.

error_message.description: A custom message when uniqueness is broken

linked_fields.description: For uniq_type=2: an array of names or IDs of the other fields

uniq_type.description: 0 = none, 1 = strictly unique, 2 = multi (a combination of fields)

validations.description: The field's checks. required: true is the shorter way to make it required. They check the text typed into the add or edit form, in the browser: none reads a date's weekday, a holiday, opening hours or other records (see the instruction's VALIDATIONS).

exclusion_allowNull.description: "on" — allow an empty value in Exclusion

format.description: A regexp in the form /^regex$/ — check against a regular expression

inclusion_allowNull.description: "on" — allow an empty value in Inclusion

is.description: Exact length (for text) or exact value (for number)

maximum.description: Maximum: for text — the number of characters; for integer/float — the numeric value

minimum.description: Minimum: for text — the number of characters; for integer/float — the numeric value

onlyOnSubmit.description: "1" — validate only on submit, not while typing

visible.description: false — the field's column is not shown on the table's PUBLIC page (the page, a found record, one record's own page). Signed in, the owner still sees it in their own table and in the form. For a public page prefer update_public_page hide_columns: it takes the field out of the page's search too

name: create_field
